description: This file defines the LookAndFeelManager class, which manages the look-and-feel configuration and platform-specific properties for a Java Swing application within the RomRaider project.

classes.name: LookAndFeelManager
classes.description: A utility class to initialize and configure the application's look and feel based on the platform. It includes platform-specific system property settings and look-and-feel setup, with error handling and logging.

methods.name: initLookAndFeel
methods.description: Initializes the look and feel for the application, setting platform-specific properties and handling exceptions by logging errors.

methods.name: getLookAndFeel
methods.description: Determines the appropriate look and feel class name based on the platform, defaulting to system look and feel except on Linux, where it uses the cross-platform look and feel.

search-terms: Mac OS X look and feel
